field_text_formatted.value: Press Preview, and the module fills in the template's tokens and frames the page on the Frontend tab, so the page has to allow that: no X-Frame-Options, and Drupal's origin in any frame-ancestors rule. Beside it, Drupal is core's own preview, for anything Drupal renders itself, and JSON:API is the raw document: the tab I open first when a field doesn't turn up.
